title: American soldier's off-record sighting

tellings.quote: An American soldier. I saw him on the top of my house. But if I say anything, I'd lose my pension in the US.

plain: An American soldier is said to have seen a UFO above the top of his own house but refused to say so publicly, because he feared he would lose his US pension. Italo Venturelli, a senior surgeon who has his own story to tell, repeats what the soldier told him, as a sign that witnesses keep quiet out of fear.
